title: The Apocalypse of Abraham
author: G. H. Box (trans)
description: G. H. Box's translation of a Jewish apocalypse centred on Abraham's visionary journey. The text explores idolatry, creation and judgement through a heavenly revelation that reinterprets the patriarch's relationship with God.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/apocalypseofabra00boxg).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
